name: backlinksbeheer
description: Read your existing Backlinksbeheer domains and backlinks, inspect stored check results, find problem links and summarize a domain. Results include the available measurement dates. This plugin reads only your own account; it does not run a new crawl, send partner messages, buy backlinks, modify records or process payments. An existing Backlinksbeheer account is required.
